Local Vision Transformer is a dynamic depth-wise convolution with weight sharing.

the local attention in Local Vision Transformer is similar to dynamic depth-wise convolution in the sense of sparse connectivity and dynamic computation, but the main difference lies in that depth-wise convolution shares kernel weights across spatial positions while attention shares kernel weights across channels.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
local attention is not a new component in vision transformer, but a special case of dynamic depth-wise convolution.
the Local Vision Transformer can be interpreted as a dynamic variant of depth-wise convolution, and its dynamic variants are empirically competitive with Local Vision Transformer.

local attention and dynamic convolution are two different network regularization manners that can achieve similar performance in visual recognition.
dynamic depth-wise convolution, which has been widely adopted in convolutional neural networks, can be a strong alternative to local attention for visual recognition.

the dynamic variants of depth-wise convolution, which are more computationally efficient and memory efficient than the standard depth-wise convolution, are promising alternatives to the standard depth-wise convolutions in Local Vision Transformer for visual recognition tasks.
